item.title: Tesla adds clever trick to release frozen charge cables with new software update
item.description: Tesla is pushing a new software update that adds a handy workaround for when your charge cable gets stuck in the charge port, a common problem in cold weather when the port can freeze shut. more…

item.title: Toyota’s biggest electric SUV is almost here
item.description: Toyota promised to launch a three-row electric SUV, and it might finally be making good on that promise. In a cryptic teaser image, Toyota hinted at “something new on the horizon,” with what appears to be a larger SUV, possibly the Highlander EV. more…

item.title: GM expects ‘significantly’ lower EV volume in 2026 as adjustments drag on earnings
item.description: General Motors’ (GM) recent plans to scale back EV production in the US cost the company over $7 billion in 2025. Despite selling nearly 100,000 electric vehicles last year, GM is calling for “significantly” lower EV volume this year. more…

item.title: Tesla lands major Semi charging deal with nation’s largest truck stop operator
item.description: Pilot, the nation’s largest operator of travel centers, has announced a partnership with Tesla to install Semi chargers at select locations along major highway corridors. The first sites are expected to open in Summer 2026. more…

item.title: The Hyundai Kona is getting a sleek new look, and it looks a lot like this EV concept [Video]
item.description: The Hyundai Kona is about to look a lot different. Hyundai is scrapping plans for a mid-cycle facelift and will instead introduce an entirely new Kona. more…

item.title: EVgo bets on NACS as Tesla’s charging port takes over US EVs
item.description: EVgo is betting big on Tesla’s charging standard. After a 2025 pilot that put nearly 100 NACS connectors online across 22 major metro areas, the public fast-charging provider says it plans to scale quickly, with more than 500 NACS connectors expected to be installed by the end of this year at both existing sites and new locations. more…

item.title: This new Chinese EV pickup looks like the Toyota Hilux, but it’s only $18,000
item.description: It looks almost identical to a Toyota Hilux, but it’s about half the price. Chery Automotive launched its first electric pickup, starting at just 127,800 yuan ($18,300). more…

item.title: Trump’s offshore wind pause just lost again – Vineyard Wind is back to work [update]
item.description: A federal judge cleared Vineyard Wind to restart construction, adding to a growing list of offshore wind projects beating Trump’s stop-work orders. more…

item.title: Indiana brought a 150 MW solar farm online, and it’s just the beginning
item.description: EDP Renewables’ new 150-megawatt solar project is now feeding power into Indiana’s grid, as utilities look for more reliable, in-state generation. more…
